source.description: Surface geometry from the USGS/DLR Ceres Dawn FC Global Mosaic 140 m (Feb 2016), NCC 0.96 after a 180 degree shift; the colour and the yellow-green polar fill of the donor's ceres-2k.jpg come from an unknown source, so that file must not be shipped
source.registration: Donor file matches the USGS/DLR mosaic after a 180 degree longitude shift (docs/DONOR_TEXTURE_INVENTORY.md)

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.recentringEvidence: docs/DONOR_TEXTURE_INVENTORY.md section C: donor texture matches the USGS/DLR mosaic after a 180 degree shift (NCC 0.96)
